purpose: Reconstruct the figure from the Geometry Agent's construction and CV measurements (image pixels, y down; flip y for TikZ). Draw the labelled points A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, O at their measured position

text: The first version compiled and the critic scored it 0.9 with no must-repair issues, so I'm finishing here.

result.summary: Generated TikZ (version 1) compiles and passes validation and topology checks. The critic scored it 0.9 with no must-repair issues. It draws the circle centred at O with the labelled points A–H and O at their measured positions, with the solid segments as named paths (BE diameter, chords, triangle AHF, and the chain C–D–G with vertical EG). All nine labels are present.
